title: McCulloch letters urging CIA and Navy to check out Puharich

tellings.quote: But in those letters they were they were letters from McCullough back to these agencies saying you know you should check this guy Buharic out.

plain: Letters in a Northwestern University archive show the scientist Warren S. McCulloch writing to the CIA and the Navy to tell them, in the researcher Greg Malatzi's words, "you should check this guy" out: a man named Puharich. Malatzi describes the letters on the show and draws as well on the journalist Annie Jacobsen. If true, it shows the agencies being pointed toward Puharich by a respected scientist.
